item.title: Show HN: Fruman – A 2D souls-like game demo running in web browser
item.summary: Hi HN, As a souls-like game lover, I've tried use pure JavaScript acomplished a simple souls-like action game, it's mostly coding with AI agents (codex / claude).You can create your own map and scenes with the editor tool, and this is just a little demo. https://fruman.baklab.app Source code: https://github.com/oodzchen/fruman Comments URL: https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=49165187 Points: 1 # Comments: 0
